paper_title: Stronger limits on hypothetical Yukawa interactions in the 40--8000 nm range
notes: Yukawa-type fifth force search constraining alpha vs lambda (range 30-8000 nm) via Casimir-less differential force measurement. This is a ScalarNucleon-type (Yukawa fifth force) constraint. The exclusion limits are presented only as a curve in Fig. 4 (alpha vs lambda in meters), with no numerical table or explicit text values provided. Quoted improvement: factor ~10^3 at lambda=300 nm.
